title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 17 in A-flat major

character.text: Spielfuge of concerto type, on a verset-style subject

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From E♭ major to A♭ major

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 14–17). Returns in Episode 4 (bars 19–23).
sections.leads: From A♭ major to F minor

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bars 11–13) in part, with the soprano's line in the bass, the tenor's line in the soprano, the bass's line in the alto, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: From F minor to B♭ minor; perfect cadence in F minor at bar 16

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bars 11–13), with the soprano's line in the alto, the bass's line in the soprano, a step lower. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From B♭ minor to E♭ major; perfect cadence in E♭ major at bar 23

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in A♭ major

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From B♭ minor to A♭ major

sections.label: Coda
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in A♭ major at bar 35

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
